text: The meeting identified preparation and coordination gaps during kickoff participation, indicating under-prepared participants (problems 0).
Pricing is set at 25 Euros and the sales target is 50 million Euros.

Production cost should be half the selling price; Phase one will be the functional design; assume system for TV and video with potential future features; product must be user-friendly and have the least number of functions to simplify usage.

Actions were assigned: Industrial Designer to work on conceptual design; Project Manager to summarize items and place in project folder; Industrial Designer to create overview for three design phases; Marketing Expert to conduct internet searches and user interviews; UI Designer to specify technical functions.
